competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere geo market pages. KB kinetic-brutalist chrome for city scope: live per-city stat band + yearSeries overlay chart + sibling-city tiles + market FAQ plus FAQPage JSON-LD + Dataset JSON-LD for AI citability. Subdivision scope retains wave-2 render (no KB subdivision pattern yet).
note: Catch-all route for /housing-market/<city> (KB render, Phase 9) and /housing-market/<city>/<community> (legacy wave-2 render, preserved intact). City scope mirrors the region report (central-oregon/page.tsx) with city-scoped KbMarketData. Subdivision scope kept on wave-2 deliberately — no KB convergence roadmap wave covers subdivision market reports. Both scopes share the same JSON-LD (BreadcrumbList + WebPage + Dataset + FAQPage) via MetadataBlock + FAQBlock.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + WebPage + Dataset JSON-LD (G34 AI-citability). dateModified equals pulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live, never hardcoded. variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq. Rendered in BOTH city and subdivision scopes.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: KB chrome navigation — city scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics tracker. pageType='market-report'. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Visual breadcrumb: Home > Housing market > {cityName}. No JSON-LD (MetadataBlock owns BreadcrumbList). City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: SmoothScrollProvider
requiredComponents.section: Lenis smooth scroll wrapper around all KB sections. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbHero
requiredComponents.section: City hero: eyebrow '{cityName} · Oregon', titleTop=cityName, titleBottom='market report', data-driven lede from pulse. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbMarketHud
requiredComponents.section: City KbMarketData. §0-traced: active/closed30/medianList/daysToPending/monthsSupply from pulse; trend from completePriceMonths last 13; byTown from citySnapshots; yearSeries from buildYearSeries(completePriceMonths, 5). Pulse-timeout fallback via pulse ?? {…}. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbExploreTowns
requiredComponents.section: Sibling Central Oregon city tiles from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call, excluding current city. Links to /housing-market/<city-slug>. eyebrow 'Central Oregon', sectionId='cities'. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: Market FAQ from buildMarketFaq. includeJsonLd=true auto-emits FAQPage JSON-LD (G34). tone='muted'. Rendered in BOTH scopes.

requiredComponents.name: KbSell
requiredComponents.section: Seller conversion block fed by pulse: medianListPrice, medianDaysToPending, closedLast30Days. eyebrow 'Sell in {cityName}'. City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: KbFooter
requiredComponents.section: Full sitemap close. towns prop = siblingCities (same KbTownItem[] as KbExploreTowns). City scope only.

requiredComponents.name: PageBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home > Housing market > {cityName} > {communityName}, includeJsonLd=false. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: DisplayHeading
requiredComponents.section: Hero H1 '{geoName} housing market' in Amboqia Boriango via HeroBlock. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: Full-bleed hero with city photo, display H1, and data-driven lede. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: 4-stat cards from market_pulse_live. Shows parent-city stats for subdivision scope. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: PriceChart
requiredComponents.section: 12-month median sale price trend from getPriceHistory. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: MarketDetailStats
requiredComponents.section: Fuller closed-sales stats from getCityMarketDetail. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2). City scope surfaces the same getCityMarketDetail data inside the KbMarketHud sale-to-list KPI rather than as a separate table, so the closed-sales detail is not lost in the KB render.

requiredComponents.name: PriceBandTable
requiredComponents.section: Inventory-by-price-band table, stubbed with items=[]. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: CityComparisonTable
requiredComponents.section: Per-city comparison table from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: ContentSection
requiredComponents.section: Market narrative from MoS verdict and live stats. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: LeadCaptureBlock
requiredComponents.section: Broker inquiry form, variant='inquiry', tone='muted', onSubmit=submitMarketPageInquiry (FUB person + event + Meta CAPI). Rendered in BOTH scopes: city KB render wraps it in a <section id='ask-a-broker'> before KbSell so a buyer or general-question visitor keeps an on-page capture path (KbSell alone is a seller-only address handoff to /sell/valuation); subdivision scope renders it inline in the legacy wave-2 stack.

requiredComponents.name: RelatedAreas
requiredComponents.section: Nearby Central Oregon cities with activeCount from market_pulse_live. cols=4. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: Broker contact band, tone='navy'. primary '/contact' Schedule a call. Subdivision scope only (legacy wave-2).

optionalComponents.name: KbArticles
optionalComponents.section: Recent blog posts from getRecentBlogPosts({ limit: 3 }). Renders null when empty. City scope only.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.section: Hidden for kb-root pages (city scope) via HideChrome in app/layout.tsx. Present for subdivision scope.
layoutComponents.note: KbNav provides KB chrome for city scope.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.section: Hidden for kb-root pages (city scope). Present for subdivision scope.
layoutComponents.note: KbFooter provides KB footer for city scope.

deferredComponents.reason: City-scope KB market report focuses on market data. KbAbout lives on /cities/[slug].

deferredComponents.name: KbListingMap
deferredComponents.reason: Listing map deferred; /cities/[slug] owns the map tile.

deferredComponents.name: KbFeatured
deferredComponents.reason: Featured listings deferred; /cities/[slug] owns the featured listing feed.

deferredComponents.name: KbTestimonials
deferredComponents.reason: Testimonials deferred from the market report page.

deferredComponents.name: KbTeam
deferredComponents.reason: Team section deferred from the market report page.

required.note: Primary AI-citability signal. Both scopes. dateModified must equal pulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live. Each variableMeasured value must equal the on-screen number (CLAUDE.md §0). Emitted only when datasetVariables.length > 0 AND refreshedAt is present.
Both scopes. buildMarketFaq is the single source for FAQ items, FAQPage JSON-LD, and Dataset variableMeasured.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live geo_type='city' or 'subdivision', 10 to 15 min freshness.
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: lib/data/market/getPriceHistory.ts, market_stats_cache monthly. limit=60 city scope, limit=24 subdivision scope.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows for COMPARISON_CITY_LABELS. ONE call per render.
dataLayer.getCityMarketDetail: lib/data/market/getCityMarketDetail.ts, market_stats_cache full projection, 6h freshness. City scope feeds the KbMarketHud sale-to-list KPI (avg_sale_to_list_ratio ×100); subdivision scope feeds the legacy MarketDetailStats section.
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts, blog_posts published newest first, limit=3. City scope only.
dataLayer.buildYearSeries: lib/kb/year-series.ts. Groups completePriceMonths into up to 5 calendar-year lines for KbMarketHud. City scope only.
dataLayer.buildMarketFaq: lib/site/market-faq.ts. Both scopes. Fed pulse ?? {activeCount: null, medianListPrice: null, refreshedAt: null} for timeout resilience (G52).
dataLayer.note: All DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). submitMarketPageInquiry imported from @/app/housing-market/actions for subdivision lead capture (approved pattern).
